purpose: Sanitized cross-evidence gate summary; it is not a primary metric run.

recordFields.appBuild: build identifier for this primary record
recordFields.evidenceType: exactly one primary evidence type for this record
recordFields.taskId: frozen synthetic benchmark task or diagnostic
recordFields.sourceNodeKeys: frozen synthetic fixture node keys only
recordFields.queryKey: frozen synthetic query key or null
recordFields.status: pass, fail, invalid, pending, or insufficient-evidence
recordFields.coarseFailureReason: fixed-vocabulary reason required for failed or invalid records
recordFields.diagnosticOnly: optional exact diagnostic object for agent-assisted, human-ineligible retrieval timing

invalidTrialReasonCode: Exactly one fixed-vocabulary disclosure: no-human-benchmark-trial-started or invalid-trials-disclosed.
closedSchemaRule: Unknown result schema versions, top-level fields, record fields, gate fields, and free-form notes are validation errors. Record fields are the keys declared by recordFields; eventSummary, observed, and diagnosticOnly remain distinct contracts.
gateRule: A gate may pass only when its primary evidence and frozen denominator are present.
overallPassRule: Overall pass requires every hard gate to pass and unmetTargets to be empty.
privacyRule: The metric schema privacy-forbidden fields apply recursively to this artifact.
